about.heading: Md Wasim | Flutter Developer • AI/ML Enthusiast • Robotics & IoT Innovator
about.description: I'm a third-year B.Tech student in Electronics and Communication Engineering at NIT Raipur, with a strong passion for Flutter development, AI/ML, and robotics. I have been working with Flutter for the past one year, developing applications for both Android and iOS. I have developed multiple applications using Flutter, including a dynamic Quiz App and a BMI Calculator, focusing on functionality and user engagement. Additionally, I have hands-on experience in AI/ML, having worked on human activity recognition using CSI signals during my research internship at IIT Patna. Beyond development, I have participated in competitive programming and technical competitions, achieving recognition in events like Adobe GenSolve and Avinya at NIT Raipur.

projects.title: BMI Calculator
projects.description: The BMI Calculator App is a clean, interactive Flutter app that lets users input their height and weight to calculate BMI, showing the result with a health category and quick interpretation.

projects.title: Combat Robot
projects.description:
Participated in International Robowars @ IIT Bombay (Techfest 2023)
As part of Team Tech-Titans, we designed and built a combat robot from scratch and competed at one of India’s biggest robotics events—Techfest, IIT Bombay.

projects.title: Clap Switch
projects.description: The system is designed to detect clapping sounds and trigger an electrical appliance or light, making it an excellent addition to home automation and accessibility applications.

projects.title: Race Car
projects.description: This race car is controlled using a wireless transmitter I designed and built from scratch. It features dual DC motors, off-road tires, and a custom-built circuit for real-time control.

projects.title: Quiz App
projects.description: This is an interactive mobile app designed to test your knowledge across a variety of topics. With a sleek design and timed challenges, users can enjoy quick quizzes, track their scores, and learn as they play.

projects.title: Bitcoin Ticker
projects.description: A simple and clean crypto tracker app showing real-time prices for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin in multiple currencies like USD and INR. Includes an easy currency switcher and color-coded UI for quick insights.

projects.title: Clima
